recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Do not reintroduce Device.operationState.mode or Device.mode in core for FHIR-36207. Any future move or retirement of operation-mode terminology should be handled as a separate terminology-governance and Extension Pack coordination issue.
issue_request: FHIR-36207 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested adding a Device operation-mode value set, with the final resolution phrased as Device.operationState.mode and codes normal, demo, service, maintenance, and test.
initial_application: Commit 04efb9949f4a60599a63a9d1caf3f79c7b909f56 added source/device/codesystem-device-operation-mode.xml and source/device/valueset-device-operation-mode.xml with the requested code set. Later Device operation-state/operation commits renamed the terminology family and removed old unneeded operational-state files as the Device.operation model evolved.
additional_context: FHIR-37545 renamed Device.operationalState to Device.operation. FHIR-32565 later approved moving Device.mode, Device.cycle, Device.duration, Device.gateway, and Device.endpoint out of core Device into extensions for R6, and FHIR-47323 created the Extension Pack device-operation-mode extension bound to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/device-operation-mode. Related audits/fixes for FHIR-36208, FHIR-36213, FHIR-37545, FHIR-47891, FHIR-48924, and FHIR-47038 were already on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Device remains active in source/fhir.ini, but parsed current Device and DeviceAssociation StructureDefinitions have no active Device.operation, Device.operationalState, Device.mode, Device.cycle, Device.duration, or DeviceAssociation.operation elements. The current core CodeSystem and ValueSet for device-operation-mode already contain normal, demo, service, maintenance, and test, and the current Extension Pack operation-mode extension uses that ValueSet.
